rows.en: You mean what happened to Dr. Matsuzaki and Dr. Henry last night?
Yeah… It's the same as four years ago.

I was thinking the same thing…

These recent disappearances of scientists all over the world are far too similar to when Father, Mother and our younger brother vanished…
We've searched so hard for them… Where on earth could they have gone…

Ken… Come to my lab!

I get the feeling… that I'm being targeted too. Before that happens, there's something I want to give you!

Got it!

But don't worry, Brother! The SSI has the venue locked down tight.
The SSI?
That's us, the secret investigators.
That's right… If the SSI is protecting us, I can rest easy!
Brother, what's that!?

A robot I've never seen before…

Wait a moment, according to the exhibitor list…

"Invasion robot Trojan Horse… Made by the robot empire, the Iron Mask Party"?

Exactly… Japan will soon be conquered by us, the Iron Mask Party!

You will become mecha-humans of the robot empire!
What!?
We kidnapped Dr. Matsuzaki and Dr. Henry! Today, we take Dr. Kenichiro Kurenai…
Like hell you will! I won't let you lay a finger on my brother!
Heh heh heh… Rave all you like!!
DARK Destruction Squad! Grey Rhinoking!

Likewise, Kaimen Green!

The robot and Dr. Kenichiro Kurenai are ours! Get in our way and you're dead!
Ah, my Hiryu!?
Ken!!

…!?

Brother! Wait! Where are you taking my brother! Brother!!
Ken, go after your brother! I'll handle things here. Hurry! Hurry, go!
Sorry, Mari… I'm going!
Welcome… Kenichiro Kurenai!
Could it be? You're Dr. Deviler!?

Heh heh heh… Until twenty years ago, I was a doctor. But not anymore!

Now I am the Leader of the robot empire, the Iron Mask Party!
For what purpose!?

Heh heh heh…

I want you to hand over to us the super robot you've been secretly building: Red Baron.
Ridiculous!! I'll never hand Red Baron over to you!!
Do you want to end up like your father?

…!?

Then my father too…?
Heh heh heh… Those who defy us die!!
Ugh… ngh, damn it…
Turn Kenichiro Kurenai into a mecha-human!!
Meanwhile, Kikaider, Jiro, was tracking Hakaider, the android with Dr. Komyoji's brain.

…!?

The temple's Nio statue exploded!? What on earth just happened?
Where? Where is he?
Nngh… It's Kikaider, isn't it?
Where are you!? Come out!!
Wrecking the Robot Expo and kidnapping innocent scientists one after another! DARK Destruction Squad, I won't forgive you!
There you are, Kikaider! Today I'll tear you to pieces for sure!
Prepare yourselves! DARK Destruction Squad!
I will not fall… until the day DARK is destroyed!
Nngh… Androidmen, attack!!
Not bad… Kikaider! I've seen plenty of your power… But there are androids stronger than you!
Stop! Hakaider!! I can't fight you!
Stop! Hakaider!! I can't fight you!
That's your problem! It's got nothing to do with me… Here I come, Kikaider!!

You must be Ms. Matsubara of the SSI. I'm Kitakura, chief of the TDF Security Team.

I've been asked to cooperate with the SSI in guarding the related facilities.

It seems the TDF facilities in this district have been seized by the DARK Destruction Squad!

So you're the TDF people?

I've heard about you from the boss! But be careful! These androids are pretty persistent.
Damn… What should I do? What should I…
Damn… What should I do? What should I…
Pathetic, Kikaider!! If you won't come at me, I'll come at you!
Wh-what!? What's that sound?
Wh-who are you!?

Wherever there is evil, I will surely appear… Wherever evil is done, I will surely go.

Warrior of justice! Kikaider 01!!

Kikaider 01?

The android Dr. Komyoji built before me, who remains in my memory computer… Ichiro, my brother!?

Kikaider 01?

The android Dr. Komyoji built before me, who remains in my memory computer… Ichiro, my brother!?

Jiro!

This is the first time we've met… but we each knew of the other from our memory computers…
Brother! Where have you been all this time?
Brother! Where have you been all this time?

Right after I was built, I was sealed inside this temple's Nio statue.

When the forces of evil grew and began to move as a huge evil energy…

the computer built into the Nio statue would activate… a system that would automatically bring me to life.
Then…
Then…
Now is that time!! Prepare yourself, Hakaider!! Change!! Kikaider, Zero… One!!
Anyone who lays a hand on women and children… I will not forgive!! Toooh!
Brother, wait! Hakaider's brain is…
Brother, wait! Hakaider's brain is…

…!?

Ah, Brother!? You're all right?

Yeah…

More importantly, look at this!
Brother! It's amazing, an amazing robot, isn't it, Brother?
This is your robot! I spent four years building it for you.
Do I get on from this leg, Brother?
This elevator connects directly to the cockpit.
Whoa, this is awesome… All right, I'll smash the Iron Mask Party with this robot! I'll rescue Dad and the others they kidnapped!
Ken…
Hm?
Father, Mother and Kenzo… They were all killed!
What!?
Is that true, Brother?
